meta.title: The Silent Relay
meta.check_format: d100 roll-under skill check, written like 'Computers 40%'

acts.title: Boarding the Relay
acts.summary: The crew docks at a silent comms relay. The staff is missing.

scenes.title: Docking Ring
scenes.summary: Dark docking ring. The airlock to the hab is sealed.
tier1_sensory: Emergency strips glow red along the floor
Frost on the inner airlock window

tier2_interactive.label: Airlock control panel
tier2_interactive.result: The panel accepts a manual override. The hab airlock opens.
tier2_interactive.source_quote: a manual override will open the inner airlock

tier3_hidden.label: Torn vent cover above the airlock
tier3_hidden.result: Claw marks inside the vent. Something left this way.
tier3_hidden.source_quote: deep gouges line the inside of the vent

scenes.gm_tips: Let the silence work. Make one Fear save when they first see the vent.
scenes.source_quote: The docking ring is dark and silent

scenes.title: Hab Ring Concourse
scenes.summary: Empty living area. Doors to Ops and the crew quarters.
tier1_sensory: Half-eaten meals, about three days old
A looping station announcement with a broken voice

tier2_interactive.label: Station duty board
tier2_interactive.result: Shows 14 staff. Station Chief Okafor was on duty last.
tier2_interactive.source_quote: the duty board lists fourteen names

scenes.gm_tips: Okafor hides in the quarters. He comes out only if the crew is calm.

scenes.title: Operations Center
scenes.summary: Wrecked ops room. Logs show sabotage.
tier1_sensory: Fire axe stuck in the main console

tier2_interactive.label: Backup log terminal
tier2_interactive.result: A Helix access code shut down reactor cooling three days ago.
tier2_interactive.source_quote: cooling was disabled using a Helix access code

tier3_hidden.label: Hidden signal loop
tier3_hidden.result: A hidden program sends a signal to the planet below. It is not a distress call.
tier3_hidden.source_quote: a hidden loop transmits toward the planet

scenes.gm_tips: When they find the cooling log, start the Reactor Meltdown clock.
scenes.source_quote: The operations center has been wrecked

scenes.title: Reactor Spine Chase
scenes.summary: Run the reactor spine to the escape pods. Drones and the creature follow.
tier1_sensory: Heat comes in waves from the floor

tier2_interactive.label: Coolant valve wheel
tier2_interactive.result: Turn it to remove 1 segment from the Reactor Meltdown clock.
tier2_interactive.source_quote: a manual coolant valve can slow the meltdown

tier3_hidden.label: Creature in the ceiling
tier3_hidden.result: It drops on the last person in line.
tier3_hidden.source_quote: the creature waits in the ceiling

scenes.gm_tips: Use range bands: Close, Near, Far. Move threats one band each round.

escalation.text: Maintenance drones block the far end.
A steam pipe bursts. Body save or 1d10 damage.
The creature attacks from the ceiling.

scenes.source_quote: The reactor spine is a long, narrow walkway

connections.label: Inner airlock to Hab Ring
connections.requires: Manual override at the airlock panel

connections.label: Operations Center
connections.source_quote: Ops is at the north end of the concourse

connections.label: Reactor alarm: run for the pods
Escape pod to the planet
connections.source_quote: the pods are set to land on the planet

entities.name: Chief Dana Okafor
entities.summary: Station chief. Hides in the crew quarters. Afraid and armed.

roleplay.secret: He let the Helix tech into the reactor and did not report it.

clues.text: He saw a Helix technician at the reactor on the night of the failure.
clues.check: Calm him first. Then a Persuasion roll, or show him the cooling log.

entities.name: The Vent Thing
entities.summary: Long, pale, many-jointed. Hunts by sound.

roleplay.goal: Take one victim at a time.
roleplay.secret: It follows the signal from Ops. Stop the signal and it gets confused.

entities.name: Maintenance Drones
entities.summary: Cleaning drones with a corrupt program. Slow but they do not stop.

truths.title: Who caused the reactor failure?
truths.text: A Helix technician turned off reactor cooling on purpose.

truths.title: What is the signal?
truths.text: Helix uses the relay to call something on the planet.

clocks.name: Reactor Meltdown
clocks.when_full: The reactor explodes. Everyone still on the station dies.

timeline.text: A Helix 'rescue' ship docks. It removes witnesses.
timeline.trigger: Earlier if the crew sends a distress call.

factions.name: Helix Dynamics
factions.summary: Owns the relay. Wants the signal to continue.
factions.goal: Keep the signal running and hide the sabotage.
factions.secret: Helix wants contact with the thing on the planet.

entries.text: The Vent Thing finds the party.
